tests.title: Documents: create/body version, publish, archive/unarchive, table/grid and reload
Snippets: literal content, edit/version, archive/unarchive and SQL reload
Read Later: add source, invalid/valid position, read/unread and remove preserves source
Favorites: typed reference, rank popup, server route navigation/reload and delete preserves source
Projects/Tasks: UI creation/edit, terminal cohort trash, restore and purge
Calendar: timed/all-day UI create/edit, views, complete/cancel and SQL state
Bookmark: validation, dirty discard, create/edit/archive/unarchive and SQL persistence
Tag: create, rename, cancel delete, delete and owner SQL
Finance: category, exact decimal record, edit, usage guard and unused delete
Bookmark: real two-tab conflict preserves draft and explicit revision recovery
Bookmark: offline failure retains draft, real retry commits one row
Owner isolation: real User B login cannot read User A bookmark in API or UI
Goal: title-only creation does not require optional numeric target
Goal: numeric progress and explicit completed/reopen/abandoned lifecycle
Planner: pin, move day, unpin preserves source Task
Habit: real check-in correction, future schedule and pause/archive lifecycle
Reminder: preset, None, Exact and remove retains None intent
Files: baseline availability gate is enforced in UI and direct API
